title: SEA//SIDE
description: An off-shore music series taking the experience aboard yachts, cruises, and sailboats.

concepts.heading: Offshore Venue
concepts.body: Every set happens on the water — yachts, cruises, and sailboats sailing the Bay and the LA coastline.

concepts.heading: Music First
concepts.body: House and live electronic sets from the LUPFR roster and guest artists, from golden hour to sundown.

concepts.heading: The Community
concepts.body: An all-white dress code, a boat full of regulars, and the city skyline framing every drop.

title: HIGH//RISE
description: Corporate galas, product launches, and executive gatherings that produce music with class.

title: SOUND//CHECK
description: The LUPFR podcast — conversations with the artists, producers, and managers shaping the music industry.

title: IN//SIDE
description: Indoor live music experiences redefining what nights out mean in California.

concepts.heading: The Room
concepts.body: Warehouses, marinas, and unexpected indoor spaces transformed into one-night venues.

concepts.heading: Late Sets
concepts.body: Programming built for the long haul — doors early, music running well past midnight.

concepts.heading: Underground
concepts.body: Boiler-room framing, close quarters, and a lineup pulled from the LUPFR network.

title: OUT//SIDE
description: The open-air music series melding nature and sound into one.

concepts.heading: Open Air
concepts.body: Rooftops, gardens, and outdoor spaces — no ceilings, no walls, just the horizon.

concepts.heading: Golden Hour
concepts.body: Sets timed to sundown, when the light and the music peak together.

concepts.heading: Nature + Sound
concepts.body: Locations chosen so the setting carries as much of the night as the lineup.
